data.detail: The document is an amendment to a Master Subscription Agreement that only addresses changes to the per-seat monthly rate. It contains no indemnity clauses or obligations of any kind, reciprocal or one-sided. Therefore, the policy rule regarding a one-sided indemnity obligation is not triggered.
